## History

Leander Crawford was a resident of the village mentioned during local town gossip. While visiting [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), Miss Cornelia brought up his name to [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) during a discussion about local town affairs and Faith's recent antics.
